# Security Policy

This is a client-side WebGL2/WebGPU rendering app deployed to Cloudflare Pages.
There is no server, no user accounts, and no persisted secrets. All user
preferences (profile, engineer mode, personalization weights) live in
`localStorage` on the visitor's device.

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported | Notes |
|---------|-----------|-------|
| `main`  | ✅        | Deployed continuously to https://fractal.simundis.com/ |
| Older tagged releases | ⚠️ best-effort | Only if a security-relevant commit chain is intact |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please open a **private security advisory** on GitHub instead of a public
issue: <https://github.com/bouncemonster/swype-imagine/security/advisories/new>.

Include:

- The URL of the affected deployment (production hash or preview).
- The fractal index / render style / interaction sequence that triggers it.
- Whether it can be triggered by untrusted fractal parameters embedded in a
  share link (the app parses URL state without authentication).

We aim to acknowledge within 72 hours and ship a fix (or a documented
mitigation) within 14 days for anything rated medium or higher.

## Scope notes

Out of scope:

- Physical / social engineering against the maintainer or Cloudflare.
- Vulnerabilities in third-party browsers or GPU drivers surfaced by the app.
- Automated scanners without prior coordination.
- Content generated by the fractal engine itself (any mathematically-valid
  pattern is intentional).

In scope:

- XSS / script-injection reachable via share-link parameters, catalog names,
  or localStorage keys the app reads back.
- Denial-of-service against a visitor caused by unbounded work triggered by
  crafted inputs (e.g. huge palette arrays, pathological hybrid matrices).
- Cloudflare Pages `_headers` / `_redirects` misconfiguration leaking origin
  internals.
